name: MZKT Volat V1
armament: Adunok remote weapon station (12.7 mm / 7.62 mm) option
protection: V-hull, GOST Br4 / roughly STANAG 4569 Level 2; mine and IED protection. Game: immune to small-calibre (5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51); 7.62x54R AP and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable tyres/engine; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Chunky 4x4 MRAP-like vehicle with a V-hull, very wide stance (3.3 m)
Two doors each side, large rear door with two windows and a firing port
Roof-mounted ATGM launcher or remote weapon station
